name: The High Scraparral
approved_facts: Established WOA location; Nigel owns it.
Hut made from colourful scrap items such as toasters, kettles and car parts.
An old snooker table forms the roof.
Chairs outside; a firepit that is always lit; a functional old CRT television.
Both a location and the audience's starting point.
continuity_constraints: Do not invent layout, geography, signage or props beyond approved source material.
Its origin is deliberately not immediately explained.
